translation.summary: Proliferating in recent years “in response” to the “feminist escalation” allegedly intended to castrate men, masculinist workshops claim to help men suffering from a lack of virility. The decline of the family, imbalance in romantic relationships and rejection of biological determinism provide just as many arguments motivating these testosterone-fueled gatherings.
